title: Fusion-in-Decoder (FiD): Leveraging Passage Retrieval with Generative Models for Open Domain Question Answering
description: RAG-style models concatenate all retrieved passages and feed them together to the generator — hitting context window limits quickly. FiD encodes each passage independently with the encoder and fuses them in the decoder via cross-attention. This allows 100 passages to be processed at the cost of encoding, not the quadratic cost of concatenation.
